 Tar Heels in NBA: Coby White dishes out nine assists as Hornets snap losing streak
 Posted Nov 10, 2026 
 Coby White had six assists in his first three games this season. He handed out nine in 20 minutes Monday and scored a season-high 10 points as Charlotte snapped a six-game losing streak with a 124-112 win over Cleveland. Harrison Barnes scored 11 points and grabbed two rebounds in 21 minutes off the bench as San Antonio won 122-96 at Phoenix. 
( Tar Heel Tribune )
